summary: Capture Karpathy's autoresearch (released Mar 7, 2026) — an open-source harness + 'program.md' seed prompt that lets a bring-your-own coding agent (Claude/Codex) autonomously run single-GPU nanochat training experiments (edit train.py, train 5 min, keep/discard on val_bpb, repeat). ~66k+ GitHub stars; the concrete milestone that crystallized the 'AI-doing-AI-research' thesis.

highlights.title: Karpathy's autoresearch: agent-driven autonomous ML experimentation harness
highlights.detail: Open-source repo (Mar 2026, MIT) where a bring-your-own agent autonomously edits a single nanochat train.py, runs fixed 5-min experiments, and keeps/discards on val_bpb — a minimal harness + 'program.md' prompt-as-skill, not a packaged agent. Reported runs: Shopify's Lütke +19% over 37 experiments overnight; Karpathy's 700-experiment run cut time-to-GPT-2 2.02h→1.80h.
